t:
Underwriting is the process of:

I: Classifying the subject matter according to their degree of insurability
II: Evaluation of risks to which they are exposed
III: To decide on their acceptance along with the terms and conditions and charge appropriate rates of premium
o: I, II and III / I ?? II ?? III
e: Correct answer: I, II and III / I ?? II ?? III (from the IC45 question bank).

t: Which among the following would correctly calculate severity of claims?
o: Number of claims / Number of exposures / ????? ??
Number of exposures / Number of claims / ??????? ?
e: Correct answer: Losses/Number of claims / ????/????? ?? ?????? (from the IC45 question bank).

t: Which among the following would be an appropriate justification of price? If the rates proposed are based on reinsurance market level of rates:-
o: Adequate statistical information on the claims exp
Demonstrate the reasonableness of the variation fr
Demonstrate that the rates of the reinsurance markets have been properly ascertained
Defend the logic underlying the establishment of t
Comparison with rates based on statistics for a ri
e: Correct answer: Demonstrate that the rates of the reinsurance markets have been properly ascertained (from the IC45 question bank).

t:
At the time of underwriting a proposal, the underwriter has to estimate the probability of operation of peril to be insured in relation to:-

I. Frequency of losses
II. Severity of losses
III. Time of loss
e: Correct answer: I and II (from the IC45 question bank).

t:
Which among the following category of risks can be the subject matter of general insurance?

I. Life
II. Stock market volatility
III. Business interruption risks
e: Correct answer: III only (from the IC45 question bank).

t: In the field of insurance, in particular with reference to underwriting and rating, _______ cannot be over-emphasised.
e: Correct answer: Product innovation (from the IC45 question bank).

t:
Which among the following statements is true?

I. Product name should not be misleading with regard to the scope of cover offered under the policy
II. Except for generic names the product name should be different than names of competing products
III. New products are expected to be materially different from other products being sold by the insurer
e: Correct answer: I and II and III (from the IC45 question bank).

t: The formula for pure premium method is expressed as follows. R = (P + F)/(I - V - Q). What does V stand for?
e: Correct answer: Variable expense factor (from the IC45 question bank).

t: The document which lays down the terms of the contract of the insurance is called the ________.
e: Correct answer: Insurance policy (from the IC45 question bank).

t:
As per IRDAI regulations which among the following points need to be clearly stated in a general insurance policy?

I. Any previous policies bought by the insured
II. Record of claims made by the insured
III. Perils covered and not covered
e: Correct answer: III only (from the IC45 question bank).

t:
Poor underwriting can result in:-

I. Reduced profitability
II. Reduction in volume in due course
III. Increased marketing spend
e: Correct answer: I and II (from the IC45 question bank).

t:
None of the following are contained in a proposal form EXCEPT:-

I. Bank Guarantee
II. Surety bond
III. Claims history
e: Correct answer: III only (from the IC45 question bank).

t: The things or property insured is called ________ of the insurance.
e: Correct answer: Subject matter (from the IC45 question bank).

t: ________ is the process of classifying the subject matter according to their degree of insurability.
e: Correct answer: Underwriting (from the IC45 question bank).

t:
Rate setting needs to take into account ________.

I. Insurer's interest only
II. Clients interests only
III. Book experience of the office concerned
e: Correct answer: III only (from the IC45 question bank).

t: Identify the class of insurance against which the risk mentioned below can be categorised. Risk: Sendings of Bullion (gold), currency notes over specified limits
e: Correct answer: Marine / ???? (from the IC45 question bank).

t: Which among the following underwriters can be classified as Property & Casualty Underwriters based on their area of specialisation?
e: Correct answer: Fire underwriters (from the IC45 question bank).

t: ___________ refers to the joint assumption of the risk between various insurers.
e: Correct answer: Co-Insurance (from the IC45 question bank).

t: Overall, exposure rating aims at a premium rate or price based on _____________.
e: Correct answer: Portfolio analysis (from the IC45 question bank).

t: Identify the class of insurance against which the risk mentioned below can be categorised. Risk: Jewellers, dealers in precious stones
e: Correct answer: Miscellaneous / ????? (from the IC45 question bank).

t:
An insurer is expected to:-

I. Engage in speculation
II. Have discriminative policies
III. Design products with equitable pricing
e: Correct answer: III only (from the IC45 question bank).

t: Identify the goal of market conduct supervision of insurance business from the list.
o: Prevent insurers from investing in security market
To keep a lid on the number of clients an insurer
Ensure that members of professional organisations connected with insurance  and reinsurance business are duly qualified and competent
e: Correct answer: Ensure that members of professional organisations connected with insurance  and reinsurance business are duly qualified and competent (from the IC45 question bank).

t: Which among the following is the third step in experience rating?
o: Adjust subject premium to future level
e: Correct answer: Trend and layer losses (from the IC45 question bank).

t: A policy starting on January 1<sup>st</sup> for a period of one year and expiring on 31<sup>st</sup> December will have  earned premium  as  ________ of written premium on 1<sup>st</sup> July.
e: Correct answer: 50% (from the IC45 question bank).

t: What does a straight deductible of Rs 10000 mean?
o: Any loss up to Rs 10000 will be paid by insurer
Any loss less than Rs 10000 will not be paid by insurer
Insurer will pay losses once their total reaches R
Insurer will charge Rs 10000 for every claim filed
Annual premium will be hiked by Rs 10000 in case o
e: Correct answer: Any loss less than Rs 10000 will not be paid by insurer (from the IC45 question bank).

t:
Rate setting needs to take into account ________.

I. Insurer's interest only
II. Clients interests only
III. Expertise of the Head Office underwriting team
e: Correct answer: III only (from the IC45 question bank).

t:
Which among the following is exclusion under marine insurance for the proposal mentioned below? Proposal: Cargo in paper bags

I: Damage due to water
II: Loss as a result of sunken cargo
III: Tearing and bursting of bags
e: Correct answer: III only / ???? III (from the IC45 question bank).

t:
The data available on customers can be analysed using data mining softwares for various business concerns that include:

I. Change in regulation
II. Taxation
III. Target marketing
e: Correct answer: III only (from the IC45 question bank).

t:
Which among the following is a STEP in the selection of risks process?

I. Deciding on a course of action
II. Calculating a price to cover the risk
III. Classifying the risk
e: Correct answer: I only (from the IC45 question bank).

t: _____________ is basically the limit of sum insured up to which the operating office can underwrite the risk without referring to the Controlling Office.
e: Correct answer: Acceptance limit (from the IC45 question bank).

t: What is the first step in shifting the emphasis of the industry from the problem of "determining  optimal premium" to the issue of "improving customer relationship"?
o: Adjusting premiums of low risk customers in order
e: Correct answer: Identifying low risk customers (from the IC45 question bank).

t: List the pre-requisites for lodging a complaint with the Ombudsman.
o: Complaint must not be lodged with the insurer
Complaint must be related to a group policy
Policy must be in grace period
Policy must be a general insurance policy
A representation should be made to the Insurance Company and either an unsatisfactory reply should have been received or the representation should stand as un-replied for at least 1 month
e: Correct answer: A representation should be made to the Insurance Company and either an unsatisfactory reply should have been received or the representation should stand as un-replied for at least 1 month (from the IC45 question bank).

t: __________ is an example of packaged/customised product.
e: Correct answer: Bankers' Blanket insurance (from the IC45 question bank).

t:
None of the following is a rating factor in case of motor insurance EXCEPT:-

I. Annual income
II. Lingual preference
III. Address
e: Correct answer: III only (from the IC45 question bank).

t:
Identify the class of insurance against which the risk mentioned below can be categorised.

Risk: Deck cargo on terms wider than I.C.C.
e: Correct answer: Marine (from the IC45 question bank).

t: Which among the following is the first step in experience rating?
o: Adjust subject premium to future level / ????-????
e: Correct answer: Assemble data / ??????? ???? (from the IC45 question bank).

t:
An insurer is expected to:-

I. Not engage in disruptive pricing
II. Have discriminative policies
III. Engage in speculation
e: Correct answer: I only (from the IC45 question bank).

t:
Which among the following category of risks can be the subject matter of general insurance?

I: Life
II: Stock market volatility
III: Liability risks
o: I, II and III / I ?? II ?? III
e: Correct answer: III only / ???? III (from the IC45 question bank).

t:
Identify the causes for underwriting loss.

I. High Inflation
II. No re-insurance available
III. Fierce competition
e: Correct answer: III only (from the IC45 question bank).

t:
Which among the following things are considered in the rate making process?

I: Number of people applying for insurance
II: Number of insurers operating the geographical area
III: Utilization of the expertise and skills of actuaries
o: I, II and III / I ?? II ?? III
e: Correct answer: III only / ???? III (from the IC45 question bank).

t: Ramesh is seeking health insurance. He has had a heart attack in the past. How will his proposal be considered by the underwriter?
o: Policy issued on a preferred basis
Policy issued on a standard basis
Proposal will be accepted with riders
Policy issued on a sub-standard basis
e: Correct answer: Policy issued on a sub-standard basis (from the IC45 question bank).

t: Parametric insurance may reduce transaction costs involved in writing and administering insurance policies because:-
o: Not many people opt for it
It has large number of tax exemptions
There is less need for  underwriting rating requirements to determine the premium based on liabilities and extent of risk sharing
e: Correct answer: There is less need for  underwriting rating requirements to determine the premium based on liabilities and extent of risk sharing (from the IC45 question bank).

t: Which among the following is true with regards to Flex Rating Laws?
o: There is no requirement to file rates or policy wo
Rates must be filed and approved before they can b
Prior approval is required only if rate of change  is subsational
Insurer can use new rates immediately after filing
Insurer can change rates immediately but must file
e: Correct answer: Prior approval is required only if rate of change  is subsational (from the IC45 question bank).

t: Which among the following is true with regards to Named Peril policies?
o: It is not necessary to name the insured perils in
The burden of proof is on insurer
They are expensive than All Risk policies
Standard Fire & Special perils policy, Motor Comprehensive insurance etc. can be examples of named perils policy.
e: Correct answer: Standard Fire & Special perils policy, Motor Comprehensive insurance etc. can be examples of named perils policy. (from the IC45 question bank).

t: _________  is the method of choice for managing the complexity introduced by using additional variables.
e: Correct answer: Data mining (from the IC45 question bank).

t: Give an example of business interruption risk.
o: Loss of income during restoration period
House damage as result of fire
Slip and fall accident at your property
e: Correct answer: Loss of income during restoration period (from the IC45 question bank).

t: Which among the following comes under marketing in Form A?
e: Correct answer: Target Market (from the IC45 question bank).

_______ is an example of a class rating method.

I. Schedule rating
II. Experience rating
III. Pure premium
e: Correct answer: III only (from the IC45 question bank).

t: None of the following is contained in the Actuarial Support section of Form A EXCEPT:-
o: Periodicity of Compilation and Analysis of Data for Review of the Rates and Terms
e: Correct answer: Periodicity of Compilation and Analysis of Data for Review of the Rates and Terms (from the IC45 question bank).

t:
Which among the following is/are responsibilities of the insured?

I. Complete truthful disclosure
II. Assist insurer in cases of claims recovery
III. Grievance redressal
e: Correct answer: I and II (from the IC45 question bank).
